name: smwpatches-shared-subroutines-v2
title: Shared Subroutines v2.3
description:
This patch inserts some commonly-used subroutines into your ROM so that you can just call them with a JSL instead of copy-pasting them, which saves a significant amount of ROM space.

Note that some subroutines cannot be converted to SA-1 since either the registers become inaccessible or that they rely on unsigned math operations.
